ItemId.description: The term's 26-character id. When it matches a stored term, that term is updated; otherwise a new one is made under this id, so documents that name it keep working.

Name.description: The name printed on documents, such as Net 30.

Description.description: A note about when to use the term.

Kind.description: How the due date follows from the issue date. One of: DueOnReceipt, NetDays, EndOfMonth, DayOfNextMonth (or its number 0 to 3).

Days.description: Days after the issue date (NetDays) or after the end of the issue month (EndOfMonth).

DayOfMonth.description: The day of the next month the debt is due on (DayOfNextMonth), 1 to 31.

DiscountPercent.description: The percent taken off for paying early, such as 2; null for none.

DiscountDays.description: The number of days after the issue date the discount is offered for, the last day included.

Enabled.description: Whether the term can be chosen for new documents.

Terms.description: The payment terms to create or update.
